key_findings: Morphine in primary human brain microvascular endothelial cells dysregulated Nrf2 pathway proteins (HO-1, TXNRD1, PRDX1 up; DJ-1, catalase down).
Morphine reduced mitochondrial maximal respiration at 50 and 100 µM, suggesting redox imbalance at the BBB.
